caveats: NLC 03581 original bibliography describes 目录二卷, Wikimedia/ZJLib filename uses 目錄十卷; no original binding resolves discrepancy.
2025 article and 2026 interview report findings by the same researcher, not independent historic physical text votes.
Shared 洪武 plate lineage means distinct impressions are physically different copies but not automatically independent textual ancestors or variants.
National Library A01173 j54 is an exact secondary coverage locator only, not direct physical target glyph. Its digital availability is unknown.
No original source pixel, SHA-256, line/page/folio or photo is acquired in this batch; 1111萬 vs p56 larger literal remains unadjudicated at YuanShi original level.
A scholarly generalization about little textual difference across impressions cannot substitute for inspecting the exact 求遲疾差 leaf.
